easyPrerequisites:
You control a Food.
You have a basic Forest in your library or control a land that can tap to produce {G}.
description:
Activate a Food using Silkwing Scout's ability by paying {G} and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Food token and untapping a land.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat.
